# PLL Ads Brief — On-Demand (Sam requested via Command Center)
**Generated:** Thu 2026-07-30, ~10:15am ET | **Scope:** Ads-Agent-built net-new ads only (2 campaigns, 7 ads) | **Read-only — no changes made**

---

## 1. Scope & campaign status
- **PLL-Search-ContractMfg-2026** (id 24049588003) — ENABLED. $20/day budget.
- **PLL-Search-Samples-2026** (id 24040031889) — ENABLED. $10/day budget.
- Both confirmed ENABLED via fresh `list-campaigns` pull this run. Legacy 3 campaigns (Initial, New-Sales-Ad, Sales Campaign PLL) **excluded** from all figures below — context only, not managed by this agent.

## 2. Date windows
- **Trailing 7:** 2026-07-24 → 2026-07-30 (today is partial, ~10am ET — labeled preliminary)
- **Preceding 7:** 2026-07-17 → 2026-07-23
- ⚠️ **HONESTY CAVEAT:** the preceding window is NOT a clean baseline. Our 7 ads were PAUSED until 2026-07-20 (only ~3.5 days of real serving in that window), and the website contact form was silently dropping leads until the 2026-07-22 fix. Any trailing-vs-preceding "improvement" partly reflects the funnel coming back online, not necessarily ad performance gains. Treat the comparison as directional, not causal.

## 3. Spend / impressions / clicks / CTR / CPC — per campaign & combined

| Campaign | Trailing-7 (7/24–7/30, partial) | Preceding-7 (7/17–7/23) |
|---|---|---|
| PLL-Search-Samples-2026 | $47.66 · 226 impr · 32 clicks · 14.2% CTR · $1.49 CPC | $28.09 · 68 impr · 19 clicks · 27.9% CTR · $1.48 CPC |
| PLL-Search-ContractMfg-2026 | $76.29 · 197 impr · 36 clicks · 18.3% CTR · $2.12 CPC | $79.83 · 275 impr · 34 clicks · 12.4% CTR · $2.35 CPC |
| **COMBINED (new-ads lane)** | **$123.95 · 423 impr · 68 clicks · 16.1% CTR · $1.82 CPC** | **$107.93 · 343 impr · 53 clicks · 15.5% CTR · $2.04 CPC** |

Trailing-7 vs preceding-7: spend +$16.02 (+15%), clicks +15 (+28%), CPC down $0.22. Samples' CTR compressed (27.9%→14.2%) while ContractMfg's improved (12.4%→18.3%) — plausible normal keyword-mix variance at this volume, not a red flag. **Caveat above applies — don't read this as a clean trend.**

## 4. Ad-level breakdown (trailing-7) — best/worst
6 of the 7 ads had activity this window (3C ProductIntent-BeardOil ad group had 0 impressions — flag: dormant, worth a keyword/bid check next cycle, no action taken today).

| Ad Group | Cost | Impr | Clicks | CTR | CPC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **2A Samples-PrivateLabel-Products** | $47.66 | 226 | 32 | 14.2% | $1.49 |
| **1A ContractMfg-Cosmetic-Beauty** | $43.21 | 125 | 18 | 14.4% | $2.40 |
| 1C ContractMfg-Haircare | $15.36 | 41 | 4 | 9.8% | $3.84 |
| **1B ContractMfg-Skincare** ⭐ BEST | $12.94 | 29 | 13 | **44.8%** | **$1.00** |
| 3B ProductIntent-HairOil | $4.79 | 1 | 1 | 100%* | $4.79 |
| 3A ProductIntent-BeefTallow | $0.00 | 1 | 0 | 0% | — |
| 3C ProductIntent-BeardOil | — | 0 | 0 | — | — |

⭐ **Best performer (real volume):** 1B ContractMfg-Skincare — 44.8% CTR, $1.00 CPC, well above account average.
**Worst performer (real volume):** 1C ContractMfg-Haircare — 9.8% CTR, $3.84 CPC (highest cost-per-click of any ad with meaningful traffic).
*3B/3A/3C have too little traffic (0–1 clicks) to judge — noted, not flagged as winners/losers.

## 5. Leads — qualified inquiries & attribution (trailing-7, dedup, excludes internal test)
**12 unique inbound form leads** received 2026-07-24 → 2026-07-30 (13 raw emails, 1 duplicate delivery deduped — Tiara).

- **VERIFIED Ads-attributed (gclid + resolvable gad_campaignid): 1** — Tiara (tiarashuneir@gmail.com), 7/27, landing `/collections/sample-product?...gad_campaignid=24040031889` → **PLL-Search-Samples-2026**.
- **Ambiguous paid signal: 1** — Jarrod Adams/Shay Brands, 7/28, has gclid+gbraid but NO gad_campaignid (campaign not resolvable) AND utm_source=chatgpt.com also present on the same landing page (mixed signal). Not counted as clean-verified.
- **Unattributed (organic/direct/social, not Google Ads): 10** — Veronica Diaz (IG), Marie/SOMI (chatgpt.com), Lilach/Spirit Nest, chris/lachriso, Al Needleman, Elaine/Formulation Makers, Rehman Ghani, alex/shopokami, Keyla Mendez, Joah.

Outcome mix (per LEAD_OUTCOMES.md, current status): 2 qualified (Veronica Diaz, Joah), 1 not-qualified (Elaine — out-of-scope ingestible supplement), 9 pending. (Booked-call leads counted separately in §6 by call date, not lead date.)

## 6. Booked calls (trailing-7 window, by lead date 7/24–7/30)
**3 booked calls:** Bennett/Vellume (lead 7/24, call held 7/27), Yianni/Gridlot Partners (lead 7/24, call booked for 7/29), Constance/aleta (lead continuation, call booked 7/30). **All 3 are organic/direct or ConvertFlow-outbound leads — 0 are paid-attributed.**

## 7. CPL & cost-per-booked-call
- **CPL, all leads:** $123.95 / 12 leads = **$10.33/lead** (blended, includes unattributed organic traffic riding alongside paid — not a true paid-CPL).
- **CPL, verified-paid leads only:** $123.95 / 1 verified lead = **$123.95** (Samples-only view: $47.66/1 = $47.66). This number is high mainly because attribution capture is thin (83% of leads carry no ad click ID), not necessarily because paid traffic underperforms — most site traffic converting to leads right now can't be attributed either way.
- **ContractMfg CPL (verified-paid): NOT MEASURABLE** — 0 verified-paid leads against $76.29 spend this window.
- **Cost per booked call: NOT MEASURABLE from paid spend** — 0 of the 3 booked calls in this window are paid-attributed. (If forced to a loose blended view: $123.95 total lane spend / 3 booked calls = $41.32, but this is NOT a real attributed CPL and shouldn't be used for budget decisions.)

## 8. Best / worst search terms
**TOOL-BLOCKED.** The `search_term_view` GAQL resource is not exposed by the current `google_ads-create-report` tool family (only ad_group/ad_group_ad/campaign/customer supported). Search-term mining and negative-keyword additions have been blocked since this gap was first found (2026-07-21); ~68 new-lane clicks have accrued in the trailing-7 window, past the review threshold. No search terms fabricated. Needs a tool/API upgrade to resolve.

## 9. Wasted spend (inferred, not search-term-confirmed)
No search-term-level waste can be confirmed (see §8). From available signals: no single ad group shows a full week of spend with zero clicks (i.e., no outright non-serving budget burn). The closest waste signal is 1C ContractMfg-Haircare's $3.84 CPC (highest among active ads) against only 4 clicks — too small a sample to call definitively wasteful, flagged for next review once volume grows.

## 10. Budget-cap compliance
- **Daily cap $30/day (combined new-ads lane):** 6 of 7 days in the trailing window were under cap. **2026-07-28 was over: $38.40 (128% of $30)** — driven by ContractMfg alone hitting $36.91 (185% of its own $20/day), a normal Google Ads daily-cap smoothing over-delivery (within Google's allowed 2x), already flagged in the 7/28 nightly brief. No repeat over-delivery since.
- **Weekly cap $210/week:** trailing-7 combined = **$123.95 (59% of cap) — UNDER.**

## 11. Funnel health
- Contact form: **working** since the 2026-07-22 fix (was silently dropping submissions before that — see FUNNEL_BREAK_2026-07-22.md).
- Attribution capture (Lead Source / Click Id / Landing Page / Referrer fields): **live and verified** since 2026-07-27 (first clean gclid+campaign-ID lead = Tiara). Coverage is still thin — most leads arrive with no ad click ID, meaning many real paid clicks are converting into leads we can't yet tag as paid.
- Landing pages for all 7 ad groups: live (per OPERATING_NOTES mapping), no reported 404s or broken links this window.

## 12. Standard close
- **What I saw (1 fact):** In the trailing 7 days, our 7 net-new ads spent $123.95 of the $210 weekly cap (59%, under) and drove 12 unique inbound leads, but only 1 of those 12 carries clean Google Ads attribution (gclid + resolvable campaign ID).
- **What it means (respect sample size):** With only 1 cleanly-attributed lead, we cannot yet say whether paid traffic is converting well or poorly — the bottleneck right now is attribution coverage, not necessarily ad performance. Cap compliance and CTR/CPC efficiency both look healthy at this volume.
- **Recommended next action (exactly 1):** Prioritize resolving the `search_term_view` tool gap (engineering/tooling fix, not a budget change) so negative-keyword mining can finally run against the ~68 accumulated new-lane clicks — this is the highest-leverage fix available before scaling spend further, since it's been blocked since 7/21 with clicks now well past the review threshold.
- **Approval required:** **No.** This is a tooling/process fix, not a budget, bid, or campaign change. No dollar amounts are being altered. Budgets recommended to hold flat as-is ($20 ContractMfg / $10 Samples, $30/day combined, $210/week cap) — no change requested this cycle.

---
*Full data pulled fresh this run via Google Ads (list-campaigns + campaign/ad reports, CUSTOM date ranges) and Outlook (mailer@shopify.com lead search + full-body attribution field extraction). No campaign, ad, keyword, bid, budget, or landing-page changes were made.*
spoken_text: Here's the ads brief: over the last 7 days our two new campaigns spent about $124 of the $210 weekly cap, so we're well under budget. We got 12 real leads, but only one of them can be clearly traced back to a Google ad click, so we genuinely can't tell yet whether paid traffic is converting well or not — that's an attribution gap, not a performance problem. Click-through rates and cost-per-click both look healthy. My one recommendation: fix the search-term reporting tool gap so we can finally clean up wasted keyword spend — no budget change needed or requested right now.
